data.long_meaning: The name Nemil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimila' which means 'relaxed' or 'free'. In Hindu mythology, Nemil is a name given to Lord Vishnu in his reclined form. It represents a state of peace and tranquility, and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Nemil carries the meaning “Relaxed, Free” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nemil usually hope their child will grow to embody relaxed, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
